We’re honored and grateful 

Reading this story in the Tri-City Herald reminded us why Azúcar exists — because our community deserves a space to dance, connect, and be unapologetically ourselves.

For nearly 30 years, Out and About has been more than a bar — it’s been home for so many. Today, Azúcar at Out and About continues that legacy with a fresh Latin heartbeat and the same spirit of love and belonging. ❤️

Felicidades, Calixto — y gracias.

Meet & Greet with Pasco’s New City Council Member, Calixto Hernández! 

📅 December 16th • 🕖 7:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out and About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

Pasco, this is a special moment for our community.
Calixto Hernández — born, raised, and shaped by our city — has officially been sworn in as our newest representative for District 6, the historic heart of downtown where so many families live, work, and dream.

Calixto knows our neighborhood because he’s been part of it his whole life. Many of us have seen him around for years, showing up, supporting our spaces, and sharing in the same community spirit that makes Pasco so unique. His presence has always meant something here at Azucar at Out and About — and now, it means even more.

This is your chance to meet him, connect, and talk about the bright future of our city and District 6.
We’ll have light drinks, snacks, and a welcoming space for conversation and celebration.

Let’s come together to congratulate Calixto, honor this milestone, and show him the love and community that raised him. 

Nos vemos el 16 de diciembre — te esperamos. 🌈

🌈 Pride & Connections: A Queer Social

Celebrate Community. Make Friends. Get Involved.

Looking to expand your circle or get more involved with the local scene? 
Whether you’re a long-time local or new to the Tri-Cities, join us for an evening dedicated to connection, community, and queer joy!

📍 The Details
• When: March 8th | Starts at 6:00 PM
• Where: Azucar at Out and About
• Cost: FREE Admission
• Age: 18+ (Main dance floor and social areas)

✨ What’s Happening?
We’re transforming the bar into the ultimate hangout spot. This isn't just a night out; it’s a space to build lasting friendships.

• Social Lounges & Games: Skip the small talk! We’ll have dedicated lounge areas and games designed to help you break the ice and meet new people in a relaxed environment.
• Get Involved: Meet the folks from PFLAG! This is the perfect opportunity to learn more about the upcoming Tri-Cities Pride Festival (June 14th) and find out how you can volunteer or participate.
• A Safe Space: Whether you’re looking to come out for the first time or just looking for your "found family," our doors are open.

🍔 Food & Drink Specials
We’ve got something for everyone, whether you’re hitting the bar or staying sober:
• 21+: Exclusive drink and appetizer specials.
• Under 21: Special deals on Soda, Red Bull, and our delicious appetizer menu!

Come out, make friends, and let's get ready for Pride season together!

✨ AZÚCAR DRAG COMPETITION ✨

This is a show you DO NOT want to miss.

This Saturday, March 7th, the stage at Azúcar is heating up with a drag competition featuring five fierce queens battling it out for the chance to open for our RuPaul girls takeover on March 14th.

And the power is in YOUR hands… come out and vote for your favorite queen and help decide who gets the spotlight.

Doors open at 8:30 PM
Show starts at 10:00 PM sharp — baby, we start on time because the drama waits for no one.

👑 Hosted by the incomparable Miss Rohla Blunt — a queen known for her razor-sharp wit, commanding stage presence, and the kind of charisma that can make a whole room behave… or misbehave. If you’ve seen Rohla host before, you already know she brings the sass, the shade, and the showmanship.

✨ And joining her as co-host is the stunning Abel — beautiful, charming, and ready to keep the crowd screaming all night long. We’re excited to have her bringing her energy to the Azúcar stage.

Now let’s talk about the queens stepping into the ring:

🔥 Bali – exotic, elegant, and ready to serve looks so hot you’ll think the stage caught on fire.

💎 Victoria – polished, powerful, and the kind of queen who walks in like she already owns the crown.

🍭 Lolli Poppins – sweet, colorful, and chaotic in the best way… don’t let the sugar fool you, she’s here to dominate.

✨ Abel – glamorous, captivating, and serving beauty so dangerous it should come with a warning label.

⚡ Ember – fierce, fiery, and ready to burn the stage down one lip sync at a time.

There will be two rounds of elimination and then a lip sync for your life to decide who takes the win.

📲 Reserve your tables now so you can be front and center.
You want to be so close to the queens you might catch a wig flip, a heel kick… or a little glitter in your drink.

Grab your friends, bring your screams, and get ready for a night of drama, glamour, and pure drag chaos.

May the best queen win. 💅

NOCHE VAQUERA
Sábado 9 de Mayo | Azucar at Out & About
Compadres... esta noche no es para los que se quedan en casa. 😏🔥
La noche más caliente del Pacifico Noroeste está de vuelta, y esta vez viene con más cuero, más pelo, más botas... y mucho más actitud. 💪🏽👢
Si eres VAQUERO, OSO, o de los que les gusta el CUERO — esta noche fue hecha para ti. Trae tu sombrero, ajústate las botas, ponte esa vest que tanto te gusta y ven a demostrar de qué estás hecho. 🐻🤠
¿Que qué hay de especial esta noche?
✨ La inigualable, la incomparable, la única FRIVOLA abre la noche con un show de drag que te va a dejar sin palabras — y posiblemente sin aliento. Perfecta para los vaqueros que saben apreciar el arte... y el escándalo. 💃🏽🎤
🌟 INVITADO ESPECIAL DEL MES — sorpresa que cambia cada mes, porque aquí no nos gusta aburrirnos. Y tú tampoco deberías. 😉
🚪 Puertas abren: 8:30 PM
🎭 Show comienza: 9:30 PM — en punto, mijos, que aquí sí arrancamos.
💚 ENTRADA LIBRE si llegas con:
👢 Botas + sombrero de vaquero
🖤 Vest de cuero O sombrero de cuero
Sí, así como lo lees. Vístete pa' la ocasión y la noche es tuya. 🙌🏽
📞 RESERVA TU MESA — No te quedes parado en la puerta como si no supieras a lo que viniste. Las mesas vuelan, y los que llaman primero, bien sentaditos se quedan. 😈 Llámanos para reservar.
Noche Vaquera es CADA SEGUNDO SÁBADO DEL MES — porque la buena vida no puede esperar más de dos semanas. 🐂🖤
¿Vas a dejar que la noche pase sin ti? 👀
Ven. Huele a cuero. Siente la música. Y deja que la noche te haga lo que el día no pudo. 😏🔥

Come shop.

Come feel the love. 💛🌵🏳️‍🌈

Frivola does not simply host a show, she runs the entire kingdom. When she takes that microphone, the room falls in line. You sit down, you pay attention, and yes, you tip her well. There is a reason every queen in the area knows her name, and a reason the crowd treats her like royalty.

We are beyond honored to have her gracing our Latino/a Pride stage this year. Come witness the queen who paved the way and somehow still does it better than most.

Twenty years in the making 💃

Valeria Sanchez is the kind of artist you only get to witness if you are paying attention. She trained at the Escuela de Bellas Artes in both Mexican folklórico and flamenco, and she has carried that training onto stages all around the world. Twenty years of dedication to her craft, and she is nowhere near slowing down. On top of performing, she teaches, passing everything she knows on to the next generation of dancers.

At Latino/a Pride she takes the stage as a soloist. When the music starts and that skirt begins to fly, you will understand exactly why people call this an art form. It is power, history, and pure beauty all moving at once, and it is rare to see it this close to home.

Do not look away for a second. You are going to want to remember this one.

201644454280_1598550345606424.message:
Folklórico royalty, right here at home 👢

For the very first time at Azúcar, we get to welcome Ballet Folklórico Cielo de México to our Pride stage. This is a local Tri Cities treasure, a crew of five to ten dancers bringing the traditional dances of northern México to life with the skirts, the boots, and the zapateado that you feel in your chest.

These dancers perform all throughout the year, and their famous annual showcase is honestly one of the most beautiful things you can experience locally. If you have never seen it, put it on your list, because it is the kind of show people talk about for weeks afterward. For now, we are lucky enough to have them at Azúcar, and we could not be more proud to share our stage with them.

They also teach all ages, so if watching them makes you want to learn, they are the ones to find. Come celebrate culture that lives and breathes right here at home.

We’re celebrating Lesbian & Lencha Pride Night Market at Azúcar at Out & About.

A night full of color, community, and pride featuring 15+ local women-owned vendors, live music, DJs spinning all night, and closing out the evening with a drag show and burlesque performance before the dance floor opens up.

This event is created to center and celebrate women, lesbians, lenchas, queer women, sapphics, trans women, nonbinary community, and our invited friends and allies.

Six days from tonight, Azúcar is turning into a crafting wonderland. 🌈🔑

We're calling it Build Your Own Carabiner Night, but really, it's an excuse to get our community in one room, hands busy, hearts open, and music playing while we make something to carry with us long after the night ends.

Here's the thing about a carabiner — it's built to hold things together. A ring for your keys, a clip for your bag, a small piece of hardware that keeps what matters close. We loved that symbolism enough to build an entire night around it, because that's what we're trying to do as a community too: hold each other, hold space, and hold on to the connections we've built all summer long.

On Sunday, July 12th from 7–10 PM, grab a carabiner, pick your charms, and build something that's completely, unapologetically you. Come solo and leave with new friends, or bring your whole crew and make a night of it. Either way, you're not just building an accessory — you're building community.

Tickets are $10 at the door, and every dollar goes toward funding our upcoming Sapphic events. Mark your calendar, because this one's going to fill up fast.

📍 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

201644454280_1626774789450646.message:
Five days out, and we want to tell you why we picked a carabiner as the centerpiece of this whole night. 🏳️‍🌈

It's a small piece of hardware most of us carry without thinking twice. But look closer and it's actually a tiny engineering marvel — a loop that opens just wide enough to let something new in, then locks tight enough to never let it go. That's a pretty perfect metaphor for the kind of spaces we're trying to build at Azúcar: open enough for anyone to step into, strong enough that once you're part of this community, you're held.

This Sunday, July 12th from 7–10 PM, you'll get to pick your own carabiner, build it out with charms — think tiny florals, rainbow hearts, cowgirl boots, star charms, and a few surprises we're not spoiling yet — and walk away with something that's part accessory, part memory, part inside joke with whoever's sitting next to you at the craft table.

And here's the part that matters most: every single dollar raised goes directly toward funding our upcoming Sapphic events. So when you clip that carabiner to your bag, you're not just showing off your bedazzling skills — you're wearing proof that you helped build something bigger.

$10 at the door. Doors open at 7 PM.

📍 327 W Lewis St, Pasco, WA

201644454280_1718593920268732.message:
BIG HAIR, BIG HEARTS & A WHOLE LOT OF LOVE! 

From La Familia Azúcar, THANK YOU! 🌈✨
Our Dolly Parton Drag Show Fundraiser was filled with laughter, fabulous performances, dancing, and most importantly, a community coming together to make a difference.
TOGETHER, WE RAISED $650! 
But this night wouldn't have been possible without the incredible people who stepped up and made it happen!
We want to give an EXTRA SPECIAL THANK YOU to VictoriaDeMizer, whose dedication, leadership, and heart helped bring this beautiful fundraiser to life.
And a huge round of applause for our fabulous performers Cherry Pop, Puddlezz, Zero, and Bea! Thank you for sharing your talent, creativity, time, and energy to make this night unforgettable!
A very special thank-you also goes to José from Cabana Bass for being part of this wonderful effort and helping make it all possible!
You didn't just put on a show. You brought people together for a purpose. And that deserves to be celebrated! 
We're proud to share that the $650 raised will be donated to two wonderful causes:

♥️Dolly Parton's Imagination Library, helping put books into the hands of children right here in Benton and Franklin Counties.
❤️ WAISN Worker Collective, supporting and uplifting members of our community.

Because isn't that exactly what Dolly would have done? Spread kindness, lift others up, and use whatever spotlight you have to make the world a little brighter.
To everyone who showed up, bought a drink, tipped a queen, danced, laughed, or simply came to support 

THANK YOU!

At Azúcar, we're more than just a nightclub. We're a familia. And nights like this remind us that when our community comes together, we can have an amazing time while making a meaningful difference.
A little country, a lot of glitter, and a whole lot of HEART! 

With all our love and gratitude,
LA FAMILIA AZÚCAR

🔞 18+
